top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings since this morning's edition
top_story.dek: Every request for additional information and Form 99 in the October 2–5 window was already covered earlier today.
paragraphs: The FEC filings API returned 6 requests for additional information and 14 Form 99 submissions received since October 2. All of them appeared in this morning's edition or an earlier one, so nothing new is reported here.
The deterministic checks for missing reports, megadonor gifts, Money Out findings and outside spending also found nothing new.

sections.headline: Nothing new to report
paragraphs: No FEC filings surfaced in this window that hadn't already been reported in a prior edition.
